karoṣi tāneva punarnavāntsadā ato mahākāruṇikāya te namaḥ . . 44
1.123.d:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशा ऊचुः
नमोनमः सुरवर तिग्मतेजसे नमोनमः सुरवर संस्तुताय वै ।
जडान्धमूकान्बधिरान्सकुष्ठान्सश्वित्रिणोंऽधान्विविधव्रणावृतान् ॥
करोषि तानेव पुनर्नवान्त्सदा अतो महाकारुणिकाय ते नमः ॥ 44
1.123.m:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva said:
"Salutations, salutations to the best of gods of fierce radiance! Salutations, salutations to the best of gods who is praised! / Those who are inert, blind, mute, deaf, afflicted with leprosy, white-leprous, blind, and covered with various sores— / you make them fresh and new again continually. Therefore, salutations to you, who are exceedingly compassionate!

1.123.s:
yadaudaraṃ jyotiratitvaranmahadyadalpatejo yadapīha cakṣuṣām .
yadatra yajñeṣvapanītamāhitaṃ tavaiva tadūpamanekataḥ sthitam . . 45
1.123.d:
यदौदरं ज्योतिरतित्वरन्महद्यदल्पतेजो यदपीह चक्षुषाम् ।
यदत्र यज्ञेष्वपनीतमाहितं तवैव तदूपमनेकतः स्थितम् ॥ 45
1.123.m: Whatever light is in the belly, moving with great speed, whatever slight light is here in the eyes, / and whatever is removed and established in sacrifices—that is your very form, abiding manifoldly.

1.123.s:
suradviṣaḥ sāgaratoyavāsinaḥ pracaṇḍapāśāsiparaśvadhāyudhāḥ .
samucchritāste bhuvi pāpacetasaḥ prayāṃti nāśaṃ tava deva darśanāt . . 46
1.123.d:
सुरद्विषः सागरतोयवासिनः प्रचण्डपाशासिपरश्वधायुधाः ।
समुच्छ्रितास्ते भुवि पापचेतसः प्रयांति नाशं तव देव दर्शनात् ॥ 46
1.123.m: The enemies of the gods dwelling in the ocean waters, armed with terrible nooses, swords, and battle-axes, / haughty on earth and evil-minded, go to destruction at the sight of you, O God!

1.123.s:
yato bhavāṃstīrthaphalaṃ samastaṃ yajñeṣu nityaṃ bhagavānavasthitaḥ .
namo bhavannatra vicāraṇāsti sadā samaḥ śāṃtikaro narāṇām . .
yaccāpi loke tapa ucyate budhaistatte mahāteja uśaṃti paṇḍitāḥ . .47
1.123.d:
यतो भवांस्तीर्थफलं समस्तं यज्ञेषु नित्यं भगवानवस्थितः ।
नमो भवन्नत्र विचारणास्ति सदा समः शांतिकरो नराणाम् ॥
यच्चापि लोके तप उच्यते बुधैस्तत्ते महातेज उशंति पण्डिताः ॥47
1.123.m: Because you are the fruit of all sacred fords and, as the Lord, are ever present in sacrifices; / salutations to you, Lord—there is no doubt here—ever impartial, conferring peace upon men; / and whatever is spoken of as austerity in the world by the wise, the learned proclaim that to be your great splendour.

1.123.s:
stutaḥ sa bhagavānevaṃ prajāpatimukhaiḥ suraiḥ .
avadhānaṃ tataścakre śravaṇābhyāṃ mahīpate . .48
1.123.d:
स्तुतः स भगवानेवं प्रजापतिमुखैः सुरैः ।
अवधानं ततश्चक्रे श्रवणाभ्यां महीपते ॥48
1.123.m: Praised thus by the gods headed by Prajāpati, / the Lord then turned his attention with his ears, O king of the earth.

1.123.s:
stuvanti te tato bhūyaḥ śivaviṣṇupurogamāḥ .
kṛtvā māṃ purataḥ sarve bhaktinamrāḥ samantataḥ . .49
1.123.d:
स्तुवन्ति ते ततो भूयः शिवविष्णुपुरोगमाः ।
कृत्वा मां पुरतः सर्वे भक्तिनम्राः समन्ततः ॥49
1.123.m: Then, led by Śiva and Viṣṇu, placing me in front, / they all, bowed down in devotion on every side, praised him further:

1.123.s:
1namonamastribhuvanabhūtidāyine kratukriyāsatphalasampradāyine .
namonamaḥ pratidinakarmasākṣiṇe sahasrasaṃdīdhitaye namonamaḥ . . 1.123.50
1.123.d:
1नमोनमस्त्रिभुवनभूतिदायिने क्रतुक्रियासत्फलसम्प्रदायिने ।
नमोनमः प्रतिदिनकर्मसाक्षिणे सहस्रसंदीधितये नमोनमः ॥ 1.123.50
1.123.m: "Salutations, salutations to the bestower of prosperity upon the three worlds, to the granter of the true fruit of sacrificial rites! / Salutations, salutations to the witness of daily deeds, to the one with thousands of combined rays, salutations, salutations!

1.123.s:
prasaktasaptāśvayuje kṣayāya dhruvaikaraśmigrathine namonamaḥ .
savālakhilyāpsarakinnaroragaiḥ saṃsiddhagandharvapiśācamānuṣaiḥ . .
sayakṣarakṣogaṇaguhyakottamaiḥ stutaḥ sadā deva namonamaste . . 51
1.123.d:
प्रसक्तसप्ताश्वयुजे क्षयाय ध्रुवैकरश्मिग्रथिने नमोनमः ।
सवालखिल्याप्सरकिन्नरोरगैः संसिद्धगन्धर्वपिशाचमानुषैः ॥
सयक्षरक्षोगणगुह्यकोत्तमैः स्तुतः सदा देव नमोनमस्ते ॥ 51
1.123.m: Salutations, salutations to the one joined to seven attached horses, to destruction, to the one who strings the firm solitary ray! / By the Vālakhilyas, apsarases, kinnaras, and uragas, by perfected beings, gandharvas, piśācas, and humans, / by yakṣas, rākṣasa-hordes, and the highest guhyakas you are ever praised, O God! Salutations, salutations to you!

1.123.s:
yato rasānsaṃkṣipase śarīriṇāṃ gabhastibhirhimajalagharmanisravaiḥ .
jagacca saṃśoṣayase sadaiva atosi loke jagato viśoṣaṇam . . 52
1.123.d:
यतो रसान्संक्षिपसे शरीरिणां गभस्तिभिर्हिमजलघर्मनिस्रवैः ।
जगच्च संशोषयसे सदैव अतोसि लोके जगतो विशोषणम् ॥ 52
1.123.m: Since you draw up the fluids of embodied beings through rays that discharge cold water and heat, / and ever wither the world, you are therefore the witherer of the world in this universe."

1.123.s:
brahmovāca
jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyamuvāca bhagavānvacaḥ .
labdhvānujñāṃ tataḥ sarve surāḥ saṃhṛṣṭacetasaḥ . . 53
1.123.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ज्ञात्वा तेषामभिप्रायमुवाच भगवान्वचः ।
लब्ध्वानुज्ञां ततः सर्वे सुराः संहृष्टचेतसः ॥ 53
1.123.m:
Brahmā said:
Knowing their intention, the Lord spoke [these] words. / Then all the gods, having received permission, delighted in mind,

1.123.s:
tvaṣṭāraṃ pūjayāmāsurmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ .
viśvakarmā tavādeśātkarotu tava saumyatām . . 54
1.123.d:
त्वष्टारं पूजयामासुर्मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः ।
विश्वकर्मा तवादेशात्करोतु तव सौम्यताम् ॥ 54
1.123.m: honoured Tvaṣṭṛ with actions of mind, speech, and body: / "May Viśvakarman, by your command, bring about your gentle form."

1.123.s:
tatastu tejaso rāśiṃ sarvakarmavidhānavit .
bhramimāropayāmāsa viśvakarmā vibhāvasum . . 55
1.123.d:
ततस्तु तेजसो राशिं सर्वकर्मविधानवित् ।
भ्रमिमारोपयामास विश्वकर्मा विभावसुम् ॥ 55
1.123.m: Then Viśvakarman, skilled in the rule of all actions, / mounted that heap of radiance, the sun, upon a lathe.

1.123.s:
amṛtenābhiṣiktasya tadā sūryasya vai vibhoḥ .
tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre viśvakarmā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ . . 56
1.123.d:
अमृतेनाभिषिक्तस्य तदा सूर्यस्य वै विभोः ।
तेजसः शातनं चक्रे विश्वकर्मा शनैः शनैः ॥ 56
1.123.m: Of the all-pervading sun, who was then sprinkled with nectar, / Viśvakarman performed the paring away of the brilliance little by little.

1.123.s:
ājānulikhitaścāsau samurāsurapūjitaḥ .
nābhyanandattato deva ullekhanamataḥ param . . 57
1.123.d:
आजानुलिखितश्चासौ समुरासुरपूजितः ।
नाभ्यनन्दत्ततो देव उल्लेखनमतः परम् ॥ 57
1.123.m: And when he was pared down to the knees, worshipped by gods and asuras, / the God thereafter did not approve any further scraping.

1.123.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti devasya caraṇau nityasaṃvṛtau .
tāpayanglāpayaṃścaiva yuktatejo'bhavattadā . . 58
1.123.d:
ततः प्रभृति देवस्य चरणौ नित्यसंवृतौ ।
तापयन्ग्लापयंश्चैव युक्ततेजोऽभवत्तदा ॥ 58
1.123.m: From that time forth, the two feet of the God are ever covered. / Warming and consuming, his brilliance then became measured.

1.123.s:
yaccāsya śātitaṃ tejastena cakraṃ vinirmitam .
yena viṣṇurjaghānogrānsadā vai daityadānavān . . 59
1.123.d:
यच्चास्य शातितं तेजस्तेन चक्रं विनिर्मितम् ।
येन विष्णुर्जघानोग्रान्सदा वै दैत्यदानवान् ॥ 59
1.123.m: And the brilliance of his that was pared away—from that the discus was fashioned, / with which Viṣṇu constantly slew the fierce daityas and dānavas.

1.123.s:
śūlaśaktigadāvajraśarāsanaparaśvadhān .
devatānāṃ dadau kṛtvā viśvakarmā mahāmatiḥ . . 1.123.60
1.123.d:
शूलशक्तिगदावज्रशरासनपरश्वधान् ।
देवतानां ददौ कृत्वा विश्वकर्मा महामतिः ॥ 1.123.60
1.123.m: Making the trident, the spear, the mace, the thunderbolt, the bow, and the battle-axe, / the wise Viśvakarman gave [them] to the deities.

1.123.s:
tridevanirmitaṃ stotraṃ sandhyayorubhayorjapan .
kulaṃ punāti puruṣo vyādhibhirna ca pīḍyate . . 61
1.123.d:
त्रिदेवनिर्मितं स्तोत्रं सन्ध्ययोरुभयोर्जपन् ।
कुलं पुनाति पुरुषो व्याधिभिर्न च पीड्यते ॥ 61
1.123.m: Muttering at both twilight junctures this hymn composed by the three gods, / a man purifies his lineage and is not afflicted by diseases.

1.123.s:
prajāvānsiddhakarmā ca jīvetsāgraṃ śaracchatam .
putravāndhanavāṃścaiva sarvatra cāparājitaḥ . .
hitvā puraṃ bhūtamayaṃ gacchetsṛryamayaṃ puram . . 62
1.123.d:
प्रजावान्सिद्धकर्मा च जीवेत्साग्रं शरच्छतम् ।
पुत्रवान्धनवांश्चैव सर्वत्र चापराजितः ॥
हित्वा पुरं भूतमयं गच्छेत्सृर्यमयं पुरम् ॥ 62
1.123.m: Blessed with offspring, successful in his deeds, he will live for a full hundred autumns; / endowed with sons and wealth, and undefeated everywhere, / leaving behind the physical city, he goes to the city of the sun.

1.123.s:
bhūyo'pi tuṣṭuvurdevāstathā devarṣayo ravim .
vāgbhiritthamaśeṣasya trailokyasya samāgatāḥ . . 63
1.123.d:
भूयोऽपि तुष्टुवुर्देवास्तथा देवर्षयो रविम् ।
वाग्भिरित्थमशेषस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य समागताः ॥ 63
1.123.m: Again, the gods and divine seers assembled from the entire three worlds / praised the sun with words in this manner.

1.123.s:
devā ūcuḥ
namaste1 ravirūpāya somarūpāya te namaḥ .
namo yajuḥ svarūpāyātharvāyāṅgirase2 namaḥ . . 64
1.123.d:
देवा ऊचुः
नमस्ते1 रविरूपाय सोमरूपाय ते नमः ।
नमो यजुः स्वरूपायाथर्वायाङ्गिरसे2 नमः ॥ 64
1.123.m:
The gods said:
"Salutations to you whose form is the sun! Salutations to you whose form is the moon! / Salutations to you whose nature is the Yajus! Salutations to Atharva and Aṅgiras!

1.123.s:
jñānaikadhāmabhūtāya3 nirdhūtatamase namaḥ .
śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya nistattvāyāmalātmane . . 65
1.123.d:
ज्ञानैकधामभूताय3 निर्धूततमसे नमः ।
शुद्धज्योतिःस्वरूपाय निस्तत्त्वायामलात्मने ॥ 65
1.123.m: Salutations to the one who is the sole abode of knowledge, whose darkness is shaken off! / Salutations to the pure soul devoid of material elements, whose nature is pure light!

1.123.s:
namo'khilajagadvyāptisvarūpāyātmamūrtaye ..
sarvakāraṇabhūtāya niṣṭhāyai jñānacetasām..66..
1.123.d:
नमोऽखिलजगद्व्याप्तिस्वरूपायात्ममूर्तये ॥
सर्वकारणभूताय निष्ठायै ज्ञानचेतसाम्॥66॥
1.123.m: Salutations to the embodiment of the self, whose nature is the pervading of the entire world! / To the one who is the cause of all, the ultimate foundation for minds endowed with knowledge!

1.123.s:
namo'stu jñeyarūpāya prakāśe lakṣarūpiṇe ..
bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā śabdakṛte namaḥ .. 67 ..
1.123.d:
नमोऽस्तु ज्ञेयरूपाय प्रकाशे लक्षरूपिणे ॥
भास्कराय नमस्तुभ्यं तथा शब्दकृते नमः ॥ 67 ॥
1.123.m: Salutations be to the one whose form is that which is to be known, whose form is the target in illumination! / Salutations to you, the sun; and salutations to the maker of sound!

1.123.s:
saṃsārahetave caiva saṃdhyājyotsnākṛte namaḥ ..
tvaṃ sarvametadbhagavāñjagadvai bhramati tvayā .. 68 ..
1.123.d:
संसारहेतवे चैव संध्याज्योत्स्नाकृते नमः ॥
त्वं सर्वमेतद्भगवाञ्जगद्वै भ्रमति त्वया ॥ 68 ॥
1.123.m: Salutations to the cause of worldly existence and the creator of twilight and moonlight! / You are all this, O Lord; indeed, the world revolves through you.

1.123.s:
bhramatvāviddhamakhilaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram ..
tvadaṃśubhiridaṃ sarvaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ jāyate śuci .. 69 ..
1.123.d:
भ्रमत्वाविद्धमखिलं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् ॥
त्वदंशुभिरिदं सर्वं संसृष्टं जायते शुचि ॥ 69 ॥
1.123.m: Pervaded by you, the entire cosmic egg revolves with its moving and unmoving beings. / Created by your rays, all this becomes pure.

1.123.s:
kriyate tvatkarasparśājjalādīnāṃ pavitratā ..
homadānādiko dharmo nopakārāya jāyate .. 1.123.70 ..
1.123.d:
क्रियते त्वत्करस्पर्शाज्जलादीनां पवित्रता ॥
होमदानादिको धर्मो नोपकाराय जायते ॥ 1.123.70 ॥
1.123.m: By the touch of your rays, purity of water and the like is effected. / Religious duty, such as fire offering and gift-giving, does not become beneficial

1.123.s:
tāvadyāvanna saṃyogī jagatyatra bhavāñchuciḥ ..
prātarhomaṃ praśastaṃ hi udite tvayi jāyate .. 71 ..
1.123.d:
तावद्यावन्न संयोगी जगत्यत्र भवाञ्छुचिः ॥
प्रातर्होमं प्रशस्तं हि उदिते त्वयि जायते ॥ 71 ॥
1.123.m: so long as you, who are pure, are not connected with this world. / For the morning fire offering becomes praiseworthy once you have risen.

1.123.s:
ṛco'tha sakalā hyetā yajūṃṣi tvaṃ jagatpate ..
sakalāni ca sāmāni tapatyevaṃ jagatsadā .. 72 ..
1.123.d:
ऋचोऽथ सकला ह्येता यजूंषि त्वं जगत्पते ॥
सकलानि च सामानि तपत्येवं जगत्सदा ॥ 72 ॥
1.123.m: Indeed, you are all these Ṛg verses, you are the Yajus verses, O Lord of the universe, / and all the Sāman verses; thus [your light] ever warms the world."

1.123.s:
ṛṅmayastvaṃ jagannātha tvameva ca yajurmayaḥ ..
tathā sāmamayaścaiva tato nātha trayīmayaḥ .. 73 ..
1.123.d:
ऋङ्मयस्त्वं जगन्नाथ त्वमेव च यजुर्मयः ॥
तथा साममयश्चैव ततो नाथ त्रयीमयः ॥ 73 ॥
1.123.m:
You consist of the Ṛg[veda], O Lord of the world, and you consist of the Yajur[veda];
likewise you consist of the Sāma[veda], and therefore, O Lord, you consist of the three Vedas.

1.123.s:
tvameva brahmaṇo rūpaṃ paraṃ cāparameva ca ..
mūrto'mūrtastathā sūkṣmaḥ sdhūlarūpatayā sthitaḥ .. 74 ..
1.123.d:
त्वमेव ब्रह्मणो रूपं परं चापरमेव च ॥
मूर्तोऽमूर्तस्तथा सूक्ष्मः स्धूलरूपतया स्थितः ॥ 74 ॥
1.123.m:
You alone are the form of Brahman, both the higher and the lower;
embodied and unembodied, subtle, standing as gross form.

1.123.s:
nimeṣakāṣṭhādimayaḥ kālarūpaḥ kṣayātmakaḥ ..
prasīda svecchayā rūpaṃ svatejomayamādiśa .. 75 ..
1.123.d:
निमेषकाष्ठादिमयः कालरूपः क्षयात्मकः ॥
प्रसीद स्वेच्छया रूपं स्वतेजोमयमादिश ॥ 75 ॥
1.123.m:
You consist of nimeṣas, kāṣṭhās, and other [divisions of time]; you are the form of time whose nature is destruction.
Be gracious! By your own will, manifest your form consisting of your own splendour.

1.123.s:
itthaṃ saṃstūyamānastu devairdevarṣibhistathā ..
mumoca svaṃ tadā tejastejasāṃ rāśiravyayaḥ..76..
1.123.d:
इत्थं संस्तूयमानस्तु देवैर्देवर्षिभिस्तथा ॥
मुमोच स्वं तदा तेजस्तेजसां राशिरव्ययः॥76॥
1.123.m:
Thus praised by the gods and divine seers,
the imperishable heap of splendour then shed his radiance.

1.123.s:
yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejo bhavitā tena medinī ..
yajurmayenāpi divaṃ svayaṃ sāmamayo raviḥ..77..
1.123.d:
यत्तस्य ऋङ्मयं तेजो भविता तेन मेदिनी ॥
यजुर्मयेनापि दिवं स्वयं साममयो रविः॥77॥
1.123.m:
The earth came to be from that radiance of his which consists of the Ṛg[veda];
the heavens from that which consists of the Yajur[veda], while the Sun himself consists of the Sāma[veda].

1.123.s:
śātitāstejaso bhāgā ye ca syurdaśa paṃca ca..
tasyaiva tena śarvasya kṛtaṃ śūlaṃ mahātmanā.. 78..
1.123.d:
शातितास्तेजसो भागा ये च स्युर्दश पंच च॥
तस्यैव तेन शर्वस्य कृतं शूलं महात्मना॥ 78॥
1.123.m:
Fifteen parts of his splendour were pared away;
from that very [splendour] the trident of high-souled Śarva was fashioned,

1.123.s:
cakraṃ viṣṇorvasūnāṃ ca śaṃkarasya ca dāruṇam..
ṣaṇmukhasya tathā śaktiḥ śibikā dhanadasya ca..79..
1.123.d:
चक्रं विष्णोर्वसूनां च शंकरस्य च दारुणम्॥
षण्मुखस्य तथा शक्तिः शिबिका धनदस्य च॥79॥
1.123.m:
and the terrible discus of Viṣṇu, [weapons] of the Vasus and of Śaṅkara,
the spear of the six-faced one, and the palanquin of the Bestower of Wealth;

1.123.s:
anyeṣāṃ cāsurārīṇāṃ śastrāṇyugrāṇi yāni vai..
yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ ca tāni cakre sa viśvakṛt..1.123.80..
1.123.d:
अन्येषां चासुरारीणां शस्त्राण्युग्राणि यानि वै॥
यक्षविद्याधराणां च तानि चक्रे स विश्वकृत्॥1.123.80॥
1.123.m:
and the fierce weapons of other foes of the Asuras,
of Yakṣas and Vidyādharas, the All-maker fashioned.

1.123.s:
tataśca ṣoḍaśaṃ bhāgaṃ bibharti bhagavānraviḥ..
tattejasaḥ paṃcadaśa śātitā viśvakarmaṇā.. 81..
1.123.d:
ततश्च षोडशं भागं बिभर्ति भगवान्रविः॥
तत्तेजसः पंचदश शातिता विश्वकर्मणा॥ 81॥
1.123.m:
And thereafter the Lord Sun bears the sixteenth part;
fifteen [parts] of his splendour were pared away by Viśvakarman.

1.123.s:
tataḥ surūpadṛgbhānuruttarānagamatkurūn..
dadarśa tatra saṃjñāṃ ca vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm..82..
1.123.d:
ततः सुरूपदृग्भानुरुत्तरानगमत्कुरून्॥
ददर्श तत्र संज्ञां च वडवारूपधारिणीम्॥82॥
1.123.m:
Then, having a handsome appearance, the Sun went to the Northern Kurus;
there he saw Saṃjñā, who had assumed the form of a mare.

1.123.s:
ityetannikhilaṃ bhānoḥ kathitaṃ munisattamāḥ..
śṛṇuyādyo naro bhaktyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet..83..
1.123.d:
इत्येतन्निखिलं भानोः कथितं मुनिसत्तमाः॥
शृणुयाद्यो नरो भक्त्या अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्॥83॥
1.123.m:
All this of the Sun has thus been told, O best of sages;
the man who hears it with devotion obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.
